 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 20.03.2023
1.
Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.405/2018 at P.S. Sagarpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and Sections 3 & 4 Prohibition of Dowry Act on the basis of settlement arrived at between the disputing parties vide settlement deed dated 5th September, 2022 with the facilitation of Counselling Cell, Family Courts, Dwarka, which is on record of this Court.
2. As per settlement, balance sum of Rs.2 lacs is to be paid to the respondent no.2-complainant at the stage of quashing of the FIR.

It is also informed by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the marriage of petitioner no. 1 and respondent No. 2 has also been dissolved by decree of divorce by mutual consent dated 25th November, 2022.
However, respondent no.2 is not appearing before this Court.
3. Let court notice be issued to the respondent no.2-complainant, to be executed through the IO, to remain personally present in the Court on the next date of hearing.
Petitioner no.1 shall also remain present on the next date to achieve culmination of quashing proceedings.

4. List on 12th May, 2023.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MARCH 20, 2023/
& Ors vs State Nct Delhi & Anr
